# SPEC-06 — Notifications

> **Status:** v1 (2026-11-01) · **Owner of:** reminder timing and channels

## 1. Overview
Reminders are plain emails.

## 2. Channels
Email only.

## 3. Out of scope
SMS.

## 4. Schedule
One reminder per day while a loan is overdue.

## 5. Templates
Plain text with the title and the due date.

## 6. Failures
A failed send is retried three times.
